This is the only corner of the continent getting warmer: the forest edge has crept north a hundred li in a century. The Black Pine shamans think the Pine of Ten Thousand Ages is doing it, and they are right.
The summer grass line has crept a thousand li south in a lifetime as the glacier's cold spreads. That, more than any dream, is why the tribes are ready to follow a Great Khan south.
They are a cell of the [[Void Choir]]. The ledgers are hymns, and the Listeners are waiting for the one who got out to call them.
The robed body was not dead, only sealed. It woke on the ship to the Long Dusk Continent, and neither it nor the puppet master who bought it has been seen since.
The strait has frozen across in four of the last seven winters, where once a decade was a hard run. The monks have told the Myriad Sands Continent. Nobody has told the coastal kings.
The Workshop can switch off the Fair's heat with one command array. It has used the threat twice, and the Palace has quietly started training formation masters to replace it.
The She heir has been selling the family's best veins to the Yin Fire Sect behind his father's back, and means to hand his father to the slaves when the revolt comes.
Forge Street's best refiner is a [[Clear Heaven Sword Sect]] sword elder who faked her death forty years ago. She copies every blade order the Palace places and sends the list south.
The giant blood comes from the herds. Mammoth matriarchs who reached Nascent Soul took human form in the Dim Age and took human husbands, and the tribe's elders know it.
The Jar-Mothers want them dead and have sent a Gu north to do it. It is already inside the stockade, and it is patient.
The dreams are real. The Bone Ancestor is choosing a Khan and a vessel, and does not care whether the boy survives the choosing.
The lake is red because nine hundred years of blood tithe have been drained into it. The salt tempers so well because of what it remembers, and the oldest rakers hear it whisper.
The Snow Wolf chief was a salt-house hostage. The families know exactly which of their children he loved, and which he swore to kill.
The overseer skims a third of the harvest and sells it at the Hundred Herb Market. Three people knew; two of them are buried in the lichen beds.
One shield in the hall has a blank where its owner's name should be, like the blank on the Seal Watch's founding stele. The elders have never shown it to the Watch.
The hall was a waystation for envoys coming down the Ladder, and its gate opens to an Upper Realm token. The [[Armillary Pavilion]] has been quietly buying every fitting the divers raise.
They do read the messages, and they have sold copies to the Eternal Night Palace for thirty years.
The sect's master forged the cages the Palace keeps thawed demons in, and kept a sliver of demon flesh for himself. He has been eating it a crumb at a time.
This rotation's Palace elders keep volunteering for the night watch on the west wall. From there, nobody else can see the steam rising from the glacier's underside.
The Palace paid the Whale Tooth captain to make that kill. It wants the sea clans to burn the fjord kingdoms so it can take their harbors.
The stones grow a little heavier every year, and the keepers have been shaving them to hide it. They are running out of stone to shave.
The Bone Ancestor, a Deity Transformation body cultivator of the Dim Age, sleeps in a chamber at the mountain's heart and is waking. The shaking is his heartbeat.

The Armillary Pavilion is rebuilding the Heaven Ladder. Every array toll for the last thousand years has gone into it. The Pavilion Master is a Body Integration formation master, and two Star Lords at Void Refinement keep the inter-continent arrays running.
The glacier is advancing south a few li every year. The tribes' shamans say the demons inside are dreaming.
Half the warehouses on the east quay belong to the Night Bridge Society through fronts, and its runners load at the turn of the tide while the inspectors eat.
Uncle Ash keeps the peace for a tenth of every sale and a debt the Red Marrow Cave owes him, and the Cave sells its blood pills through his stalls.

The Red Marrow Cave is four hundred cultivators of a blood-refining line, keeping beasts in pens a li underground and draining them slowly. It buys live beasts from Beast-Butcher Gate disciples who want stones more than their sect's rules, and owes Uncle Ash of the Nameless Market for its life.
The Hu are fox-blooded half-bloods. Their elders can still take a fox's shape, and the Night Bridge Society is how they get their children out when a tester gets too curious.
